adaptations: Late root-filesystem loading, timer, optional per-device calibration, trusted-key-only success without a reader, reader-presence gate on the readiness unit and fprintd; units are NixOS module options, with the login screen fingerprint unit behind aurora.sep.greeterFingerprint.enable (off by default, display-manager.service in place of gdm.service, GNOME Shell named from the store) and the logind power-button snippet as documentation; no PAM or power-button policy changes. The calibration is set up on demand by aurora-touchid-setup (when a file is missing, when the enclave refused one, or by hand) instead of at every start, and aurora-sep-ready starts it once per boot after a refusal; the files are kept in /var/lib/aurora-sep/firmware and linked into the firmware path on /run. No SELinux policy, as NixOS does not support SELinux. README.md is the module's own; XART-SAFETY.md and OS-IDENTITY.md are unmodified.
